Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

I was going through some modelling photos recently sent in, one from a younger girl, and the other set from a retired woman. I was especially struck by the differences in the cover letters that they wrote: the retired woman mentioned growing up kind of an outcast and being made fun of for not being good-looking enough, while the younger girl gave the opposite story and talked about always getting compliments on how they look. Who was often found attractive?
A. The retired woman
B. The younger girl
C. Not enough information
